interactions.summary: After a student compares Satanic despair to dark fantasy battles against hopelessness, Jiang abruptly says the entire Hollywood expectation the class has built is wrong and that Dante's actual ending works by the opposite logic.

The class begins canto 34, reading Dante's approach to Lucifer through fog, ice, and gigantic scale, while Jiang pauses to gloss the devil's names and the sheer size of the figure before the grotesque details continue.

claims.claim: A student compares Satan's attack to narratives that induce despair and hopelessness by breaking a person's fundamental belief in the world, as in Harry Potter's darkness imagery.
Jiang says the class's entire Hollywood script for Satan is wrong and that the shock of the Divine Comedy lies in the fact that the expected temptation scenario does not occur.

The canto's opening presents Lucifer first as a distant looming structure seen through darkness and wind, then as a gigantic presence half-risen from ice who pushes language to the edge of inadequacy.
claims.temporal_scope: Quoted canto material read in class on 2026-06-24.

claims.claim: Jiang glosses the opening image by emphasizing that Lucifer is essentially skyscraper-sized, preparing the class to register sheer mass rather than seductive glamour.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang stops the whole imaginative exercise cold by saying the class is completely and utterly wrong and that Dante's ending works by the opposite principle.
signature_moments.source_phrase: We are completely and utterly wrong
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It is the decisive reversal that separates Dante from the modern Miltonic or Hollywood Satan script.

signature_moments.moment: Dante describes himself as neither dead nor alive before a Lucifer so huge that ordinary words cannot hold the sight.
signature_moments.source_phrase: I did not die and I was not alive
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It preserves the canto's strongest existential image before Jiang begins interpretation.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: The quoted demand for the inner strength needed to behold Lucifer's reality at close range.

chronology_notes.note: This packet marks the break between speculative pre-reading and the actual reading of canto 34, with Jiang explicitly framing the text as a correction to the class's inherited Satan script.
